Dialogs.Dialog: Yeah, a friend. We were just talking.
Hey, has it been a while since we actually talked？
Well, you look pretty busy. With your girlfriend and all.
Haha, does it look that way？
It sure does. Well, I'll get going so I'm not in your way.
Is it really okay to be seen talking to me like this？
You could at least humor me and chat once in a while.
So having a girlfriend really brightens up your life, huh？
I wanted your help, but... you're taken, so I'll pass.
Listen. Neglecting committee work over your girlfriend would be the absolute worst.
I wonder what having a boyfriend is like... What, got a problem with that？
I've heard about your girlfriend. She's way too good for you.
So, how's the relationship going？ ...Actually, never mind. Don't tell me.
Man... I just want to laze around and take it easy...
Do you go on dates on your days off？ Dates, huh...
I read a good book lately... Well, I guess you've got better things to do.
What's living alone like？ Though with a girlfriend, I guess you aren't lonely.
Juggling a club and committee work... I could never do it. I'm impressed.
Part-time jobs seem nice. I kind of want to try one.
Huh, you're actually taking your work seriously.
● is always serious, I'll have you know.
Yeah, right. Do my share too and maybe I'll believe you.
Don't push your luck. Come on, help me out.
Just so-so. Not what I'd call busy, really.
I see. Well, keep at it.
Oh, you already finished that？ Good job.
Don't let it go to your head.
▲主人公＊▲. You aren't pushing yourself too hard, are you？
As if. Having your girlfriend worry is plenty, isn't it？
With me？ Yeah, pretty good. No problems here.
Then keep that up and lighten my workload while you're at it.
▲主人公＊▲. Want a hand with anything？
Oh, I changed my mind. Forget I asked.
By the way, how are things with your girlfriend？ Going well？
Knew it. Get your act together, seriously.
...Never mind. Just make sure you're a good boyfriend to her.
What is it？ ...Oh, ▲特別デートアイテム＊＊▲.
No point in me keeping it. I figured you might use it.
That'd be great, but... are you sure？
I don't mind. Your girlfriend will like it, won't she？
It feels weird coming from me, but...
For a guy with a girlfriend, you talk to me a lot. Is that okay？
Yeah, it's not fair to her...
Right？ I thought so. Guess I was being inconsiderate.
Huh, aren't you relaxed. I don't know about that.
Feels like we haven't really talked in a while, huh？
If it's not a bother... is it okay if we talk again？
It still feels unfair to her...
Hey, have you changed somehow lately？
Not how you look. More like the vibe you give off.
How do I put it... Like you've got a warm personality.
You know, you've got kind of a cool vibe lately.
You seem more composed, especially lately.
More proactive, I guess. That's the vibe I get.
Hey. Your girlfriend changed her hair.
Huh？ How do you know that？
Anyone can tell just by looking. She probably did it for you anyway.
Good grief. She's got it rough with a boyfriend like you.
She's looking even better lately, isn't she？
It's all anyone talks about. You're a lucky guy.
Sorry if this rubs you the wrong way, but...
Hasn't your girlfriend seemed a little down lately？
I don't mean to pry, but... it was on my mind.
You walked home with your girlfriend again. I saw you.
You mean how ● act around her？ Like what？
(Wait, does she mean us being affectionate...?)
Oh, right. I happened to spot you two on a date.
Huh...? Well, that's fine, I guess.
I wasn't spying on you or anything. It was just by chance.
Haha, I know. We've been going on a lot of them lately...
Good grief. I have no interest in hearing you gush about her.
(Well, I guess people are bound to see us sometimes.)
Hey, don't couples normally go on dates？
There it is. I feel bad for your girlfriend.
Doing that at school... Seriously unbelievable.
▲主人公＊▲. Looks like you're on a roll lately.
People are talking, you know. Saying you're pretty capable.
Didn't know you had that side to you.
(Now that she mentions it, a lot's gone well lately...)
Nothing happened between you and your girlfriend, right？
Huh...？ Everything's fine. Why do you ask？
Just got the feeling things might not be going so well...
How are things with your girlfriend lately？
So-so, I guess. Pretty good overall.
You're acting all relaxed, but settling for 'so-so' seems pretty naive to me.
Hey. Looks like things are going great with your girlfriend lately.
Yeah, I guess. You can tell？
Of course I can tell, seeing how close you two look.
Aren't you two a bit too close？ Is that normal for couples？
Not weird, just... a bit much to watch. Though I guess that's a good thing.
Maybe it's just me, but did something happen with your girlfriend？
You look like the world just ended.
Sigh... What are you doing？ It was your fault anyway, wasn't it？
Come to think of it, I haven't texted her lately...
Then that's it. Doesn't she get lonely without any texts？
Just send her one already. It's not like it's hard.
Well, like how we haven't kissed much lately...
Don't tell me stuff like that... Idiot.
Maybe it's because I stood her up on our date.
...What do you mean, "maybe"？ That's obviously why.
Go apologize already. You should probably make that date up to her, don't you think？
The other day, I left my girlfriend alone during our date... and she just went home.
If you pulled something like that, all you can really do is apologize.
Come to think of it, I haven't really been seeing my girlfriend much lately...
What kind of boyfriend does that make you？
Why don't you get in touch with her？ She might be wanting to see you, too.
Doesn't your girlfriend seem a little unwell？
She might be overdoing it. Though maybe that's on you.
(Is ● okay？ Maybe I should be careful...)
Is your girlfriend out sick with a cold？
So are you gonna go visit her or something？ I bet it'd make her happy.
A while back... the two of us went out together, didn't we？
That was back before you had a girlfriend.
Was it？ Why do you bring it up？
No reason. I just remembered it, is all. What did you think I meant？
I confessed my feelings to you back then, didn't I？
Yeah... you did. Of course I haven't forgotten.
And now you have a girlfriend... and the two of us are friends like this.
Well, I'm glad we stayed friends.
You're heading home now, right？ Wanna walk together if you're free？
I'm walking home with my girlfriend.
I'm not exactly free, but sure.
What are you talking about？ You know you're free.
I'm walking home with my girlfriend.
Hmph. Not like I didn't already know that.
Oh, I'm heading home alone today.
Oh, okay. Well, you have days like that, I guess.
It's fine. I bumped into a friend and we were talking.
...Hey, will you walk home with me again sometime？
Of course, huh. Well, that's all it is, right.
Huh, so even you care about stuff like that, ▲小早川＊▲.
What's "even you" mean？ You don't want my chocolate？
Wait, you have some for me？
As if. Your girlfriend's is plenty for you, right？
White Day, huh. Must be rough having a girlfriend.
It's not really rough. It's all part of the fun.
Hmph, pretty confident. I wasted my time worrying.
Nothing. Anyway, just make sure it goes well.
...That's all, right. Yeah, that's all from me, too.
Haha, what's that supposed to mean？
Nothing. I just felt like pointing it out.
You remembered？ Thanks. Don't tell me you got me a present, too？
Idiot, of course I didn't. Who'd do that for a guy with a girlfriend？
(Aw, man. Well, I guess that makes sense.)
Must be a busy day for a guy with a girlfriend.
Try not to mess up and make her hate you. Good luck.
Actually, I need your advice on something...
Oh, a present for your girlfriend, huh.
Yeah. You're technically a girl too, right, ▲小早川＊▲？ Help me out.
Excuse me, I'm a proper girl？
Right, right. So come on, help me out.
Sigh... Running to a younger girl for help. You're a pretty hopeless boyfriend.
Whatever. I guess I have no choice, so I'll tag along.
You're a lifesaver! Counting on you, then.
Hey, it's ▲苗字▲. I kind of have a favor to ask.
I see, a present for your girlfriend...
Please？ I really wanted to get a girl's opinion.
And that's why you came to me, huh. Well, I guess I don't mind？
You're a lifesaver! Counting on you, then.
▲小早川＊▲. Sorry for dragging you out here.
What else could I do？ 'Big bro' here is such a hopeless boyfriend!
Come on, don't say that. Anyway, I'm counting on you.
I'm gonna go take a look!
(She sure has a lot of energy...)
There you are. What are you doing？
Oh, nothing much. ▲彼女＊＊▲ just spotted me...
Wait, did she get the wrong idea？
So, what was it you found earlier？
You really helped me out today. Thanks.
You're welcome. Take my advice and make sure you nail it, okay？
Alright, I'll leave you to it.
What are you doing out here？
Oh... Just hanging around, I guess.
Hmm. Doesn't look like you're alone, though？
Out buying supplies for the tennis club or something？
Did you have work today？ Is it an errand for that？
Hmm. Well, okay then. Anyway, I'm gonna get going.
Hey, have you been treating your girlfriend right lately？
Well, well enough... Why do I need you worrying about that, ▲小早川＊▲？
Because you're so hopeless. I bet you've just been letting your girlfriend do everything for you.
Honestly, you really are the problem here.
I'm talking about your girlfriend. She's way too good for you.
Man, I don't know how she puts up with dating someone like you. I'm impressed.
Sigh... I feel sorry for your girlfriend.
Being stuck with a boyfriend like you. Someone like her could do way better, don't you think？
Don't get so bummed out. Come on, step it up！
(Is she insulting me or cheering me on here...？)
Hey, is your girlfriend actually okay？
What do you mean, okay...? ▲彼女＊＊▲ is perfect！
Ugh... That's what I mean. Letting her boyfriend get this full of himself. She hasn't trained you right at all.
She does seem pretty perfect, sure, but she still has a lot to learn about handling her boyfriend.
(Listen to her acting all high and mighty.)
Hehe. Hey, hey, can I let you spoil me a little？
Where'd that come from？ Sure, I don't mind... Wait, no, no way. ● already has ▲彼女＊＊▲ as a girlfriend.
Tch, stingy. Some big brother you are.
Idiot, don't fall for it so easily！
Your girlfriend sure has it nice.
Because she can ask you for anything and you'll go along with whatever selfish thing she wants, right？
▲彼女＊＊▲ isn't that selfish. Unlike you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Really？ Still, you do pretty much whatever she asks, don't you？
I think your girlfriend's a great person, but...
Don't you think I'm a pretty great girl myself？
Hey, what's with that reaction！ That is seriously rude.
(Well, she's a good friend, I'll give her that.)
I wonder if there's something wrong with me.
What's with you？ That's not like you.
I mean, even someone like you has a wonderful girlfriend, and yet here I am...
Well, it's not like I need a boyfriend anyway.
Hey, you hang in there too!
Where'd that come from all of a sudden？
Knowing you, you're probably always thinking you might not be good enough for your girlfriend.
Don't worry about it. Even you might shine a little with some polish!
(...Is that supposed to be a compliment？)
Hey, if I'm ever in trouble, would you help me out？
Heh. Good to know. So you'll help out girls besides your girlfriend too？
Course I would. We're friends, aren't we？
Oh, listen to you. Just hope you're not all talk.
Having a girlfriend looks fun, sure, but it also seems like a lot of work. Just wondered if you were pushing yourself too hard.
Oh, I'm fine on that front! Pushing myself for my girlfriend isn't hard at all!
Yeah, yeah, spare me the sap. Sorry I even asked.
So how goes it lately？ Still all lovey-dovey as usual？
You just ticked me off for some reason.
